cohort.uniform_pair_law: Exactly four equiprobable oriented pairs: NW->SE,SE->NW,NE->SW,SW->NE. Region populations may differ, so the complete set of far pairs is not uniformly weighted across orientations. Regions are disjoint, so equality/zero distance is impossible without rejection.
